thread:
rachel: Quick follow-up on Orbit dedicated outage postmortem. Short RC: intermittent VPC peering flaps + on-prem NAT/conntrack exhaustion + control-plane reapply race. Filed RED-998 to track remediation. Posting owners & actions.

darren: I'll own peering hardening. Plan: enable BFD (250ms), lower keepalives, add 25s debounce before teardown, and ship a peering-probe job to detect flaps early. ETA Wed EOD.

mei: I'll take on-prem guidance & fallback NAT gateway config. Drafting runbook with conntrack thresholds and mitigation steps. Need customer maintenance window; tentative 2026-04-09 02:00-04:00 UTC.

oliver: Routing reapply race is mine. Implementing idempotent apply via a `route_version` column. Branch `fix/route-versioning` ready. Migration + rolling restart required. Need review + canary.

sofia: I'll own observability and recurrence detection. New metrics: `orbit.peering_flap_rate`, `orbit.conntrack_util_pct`. Alert: flap_rate > 3 in 1h -> page oncall. Adding a simple classifier to surface recurring isolation patterns.

infra-bot: Channel #incident-orbit-1745554321 created. JIRA RED-998 linked. Canary playbook attached.

rachel: Owner map: peering -> @darren, onprem/runbook -> @mei, routing -> @oliver, observability -> @sofia. Add weekly post-rollout check-ins for 8 weeks to watch for regression.

darren: Test plan excerpt: stage to dedicated-staging, run `peering-flapper --interval 5s --duration 10m`, verify BFD stability and that debounce prevents teardown. Will upload logs to RED-998.

mei: Conntrack test plan: synthetic connection flood from staging (hping3) to emulate customer burst, validate conntrack entries and NAT gateway failover. Sample commands to capture: `sudo conntrack -L | wc -l` and `sudo tcpdump -i eth0 host <cust-ip> and port 179 -w /tmp/bgp.pcap`.

oliver: Migration note: `ALTER TABLE routes ADD COLUMN route_version INTEGER DEFAULT 0;` migration script in branch. Rolling restart plan: canary one node, monitor route convergence and replication lag.

sofia: Dashboard: https://grafana.redwood.company/d/orbit-isolation. I'll add an "isolation pattern" report that runs weekly and emails the incident owners if similar signals appear.

rachel: Timeline recap: darren (peering PR + tests), oliver (routing PR + migration + canary), mei (runbook + conntrack tests + customer comms), sofia (alerts + dashboard + recurrence report). Target: next Thu COB. Flag blockers now.

darren: ack. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/networking/pull/499

oliver: ack. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/serving/pull/4099

mei: ack. Sent draft comms to accounts; holding until canary windows confirmed.

sofia: ack. First weekly report scheduled for 1 week post-rollout; recurring x8.

infra-bot: Reminder scheduled: reviewer ping for PRs in 48h.

rachel: Ops addition  add an "isolation_evidence" checklist to the postmortem deck: BGP pcap, conntrack dump, route table snapshot, control-plane logs. Include capture commands in the runbook.

mei: Noted; adding checklist to RED-998 runbook.

darren: Will post peering test logs here after staging run.

oliver: Will coordinate canary window with @infra-bot and @rachel.

rachel: Thanks all — retro scheduled Mon 2026-04-12. Please update RED-998 with PR links, test outputs, and confirmed customer windows as you complete them. :white_check_mark:
